claims.quote: Soluble N-ethylmaleimide-sensitive factor attachment proteins receptors (SNARE) proteins, such as VAMP-2 and SNAP-25, are implicated in α-synuclein pathophysiology
Both proteins were decreased in pure DLB (p < 0.001, p = 0.01)
but increased in DLB + AD (p = 0.01, p = 0.02) compared to controls
Both proteins were associated with CSF p-tau and total tau (t-tau) across all groups (r2 = 0.49-0.88, p < 0.001)
with the Aβ42/40 ratio in DLB + AD (r2 = 0.29-0.36, p < 0.001) and in AD (r2 = 0.12-0.23, p < 0.001)
and with CSF neurofilament-light chain (NfL) in controls (r²=0.10-0.11, p < 0.001-0.01) and AD patients (r²=0.01-0.08, p = 0.01 - 0.001).
CSF VAMP-2 and SNAP-25 were associated with phonemic fluency in pure DLB (r2 = 0.39 - 0.28, p = 0.01-0.03)

claims.object_text: surrogate markers of synapse degeneration in DLB
claims.quote: CSF VAMP-2 and SNAP-25 are promising surrogate markers of synapse degeneration in DLB.
